mapper.select: SELECT A.SEND_DIDID AS "sendDidId", A.SEND_MESSAGESTARTDAY AS "sendMessageStartDay", A.SEND_MESSAGE AS "sendMessage", A.SEND_MESSAGEENDDAY AS "sendMessageEndDay", A.SEND_MESSAGESTARTTIME AS "sendMessageStartTime", A.SEND_MESSAGEENDTIME AS "sendMessageEndTime", A.SEND_REGDATE AS sendRegDate, A.SEND_DIDCHECKDATE AS sendDidCheckDate, A.SEND_MSGID AS sendMsgId, A.SEND_FONTTYPE AS sendFontType FROM TB_DIDSENDMESSAGE A JOIN TB_DIDINFO B ON A.DID_ID = B.DID_ID WHERE A.DID_ID = #{didId} AND A.SEND_DIDCHECKDATE IS NULL

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_DIDSENDMESSAGE A JOIN TB_DIDINFO B ON A.DID_ID = B.DID_ID JOIN TB_GROUPDID D ON B.DID_ID = D.DID_ID JOIN TB_GROUP C ON C.GROUP_CODE = D.GROUP_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND A.SEND_MESSAGE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND C.GROUP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.SEND_DIDID, A.DID_ID, A.GROUP_CODE, A.SEND_MESSAGE, A.SEND_MESSAGESTARTDAY, A.SEND_MESSAGEENDDAY, A.SEND_MESSAGESTARTTIME, A.SEND_MESSAGEENDTIME, A.SEND_FONTTYPE, A.SEND_USEYN, A.SEND_REGDATE, A.SEND_DIDCHECKDATE, B.DID_NM, C.GROUP_NM, A.SEND_MSGID FROM TB_DIDSENDMESSAGE A JOIN TB_DIDINFO B ON A.DID_ID = B.DID_ID JOIN TB_GROUPDID D ON B.DID_ID = D.DID_ID JOIN TB_GROUP C ON C.GROUP_CODE = D.GROUP_CODE WHERE A.SEND_MSGID = #{sendMsgId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DIDSENDMESSAGE ( SEND_DIDID, DID_ID, GROUP_CODE, SEND_MESSAGE, SEND_MESSAGESTARTDAY, SEND_MESSAGEENDDAY, SEND_MESSAGESTARTTIME, SEND_MESSAGEENDTIME, SEND_FONTTYPE, SEND_USEYN, SEND_REGDATE, SEND_MSGID ) VALUES ( #{sendDidId}, #{didId}, #{groupCode}, #{sendMessage}, #{sendMessageStartDay}, #{sendMessageEndDay}, #{sendMessageStartTime}, #{sendMessageEndTime}, #{sendFontType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', NOW(), #{sendMsgId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DIDSENDMESSAGE SET DID_ID = #{didId}, GROUP_CODE = #{groupCode}, SEND_MSGID = #{sendMsgId}, SEND_MESSAGE = #{sendMessage}, SEND_MESSAGESTARTDAY = #{sendMessageStartDay}, SEND_MESSAGEENDDAY = #{sendMessageEndDay}, SEND_MESSAGESTARTTIME = #{sendMessageStartTime}, SEND_MESSAGEENDTIME = #{sendMessageEndTime}, SEND_FONTTYPE = #{sendFontType}, SEND_USEYN = #{sendUseYn}, SEND_REGDATE = NOW() WHERE SEND_DIDID = #{senedDidId}

UPDATE TB_DIDSENDMESSAGE SET SEND_MESSAGE = #{sendMessage}, SEND_MESSAGESTARTDAY = #{sendMessageStartDay}, SEND_MESSAGEENDDAY = #{sendMessageEndDay}, SEND_MESSAGESTARTTIME = #{sendMessageStartTime}, SEND_MESSAGEENDTIME = #{sendMessageEndTime}, SEND_FONTTYPE = #{sendFontType}, SEND_USEYN = #{sendUseYn}, SEND_REGDATE = NOW(), SEND_DIDCHECKDATE = NULL WHERE SEND_MSGID = #{sendMsgId}
